However, its hazard profile is incomplete for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive hazards (CMR), endocrine disruption (EDC), and organ/systemic hazards (OGN), where data are currently deficient (Tier 4).
Q2: This chemical is identified as a hazardous substance under the Clean Water Act (CWA 311-HS), indicating a potential danger if discharged into navigable waters. There are currently no available lists classifying this substance as having broadly low hazard.
